fusions.name: Deadweight Hug
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.4 seconds and goes on crushing it for 2 damage a second for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Bough Breaker
fusions.desc: Slams down with your full weight, which deals 30 damage to every enemy within 3 tiles and ignores their armour. Everything hit is [Slowed] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Chest Drum
fusions.desc: Reduces the damage you take by 25% for 10 seconds, and pulls up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Slow to Anger
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once: you deal 6% more damage per stack (48% at full) for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
